'''Nakos''' is the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] of [[Ztesh]], a [[Quia|Quian]] economy and the tenth-largest national economy by nominal [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|GDP]] in the world. The city had a population of 25,222,000 at the [[Ztesh|Zteshi]] 1764 census, ranking it the [[List of cities and dependencies by population|third-largest city in the world]] by population, behind only [[Fekhalai]] in [[Dahe]] and [[Zirohu]] in [[Areoix Lie]]. [[Ztesh]] was a co-host of the [[1756 FLLA World Cup]] under the joint [[QUFVL]] hosting arrangement with [[Erkizil]], [[Quidic]] and [[Wundry]].
